intermediate.name: Al Qudra Cycle Track
intermediate.title: Sprint | Al Qudra Cycle Track (85.4 km)

story: After early attacks, four riders formed a breakaway before one dropped out of the break within 10 km. Astana Qazaqstan Team controlled the gap at around two minutes, while Team Jayco AlUla, UAE Team Emirates and Lidl-Trek led the chase and reeled in the break. After Matteo Milan crashed late on, Jonathan Milan sprinted to victory ahead of Erlend Blikra and Matteo Malucelli.
